The '''Colossus''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Dasta]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Dasta Colossus was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the items in the Strategy Alliance Pack.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
